Achievements.Name: (island name) Miles!
Achievements.Achievement Description: You traveled a long way just to move to our little island, and you enrolled in the Nook Mileage Program. So you earned your first miles! There are lots of ways to earn miles by just enjoying island life!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Unlock the Nook Mileage program

Achievements.Name: Angling for Perfection!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Learning how to fish is an essential skill for living on a remote island, hm? Nook Inc. encourages all island residents who are aiming to become fishing masters!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Collect a specified number of fish

Achievements.Name: Island Ichthyologist
Achievements.Achievement Description: Fill in your Critterpedia with fish and earn miles along the way. Can you categorize each and every type of fish that swims in your island's waters, hm?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Collect a specified number of unique fish

Achievements.Name: Island Togetherness
Achievements.Achievement Description: One of the goals of Nook Inc. is resident togetherness. Our gregarious-greetings initiative aims to reward you with Nook Miles just for chatting with residents. Try to talk to all your neighbors every day!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Talk to each one of your villagers every day

Achievements.Name: You've Got the Bug
Achievements.Achievement Description: Earn miles just for catching creepy-crawlies! Every bug you catch is one that won't be surprising someone in their sock drawer.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Collect a specified number of bugs

Achievements.Name: Bugs Don't Bug Me
Achievements.Achievement Description: You can earn miles for filling out your Critterpedia! Can you find every bug and unlock every entry? Yes, yes, you can! And please do consider supporting Blathers by donating bugs to the museum.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Collect a specified number of unique bugs

Achievements.Name: Have a Nice DIY!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Nook Inc. will award Nook Miles for the number of DIY recipes you've collected. Think about that. You're earning...for learning! Yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Collect a specified number of DIY recipes

Achievements.Name: Deep Dive
Achievements.Achievement Description: The glittering sea that surrounds our island is home to all kinds of captivating creatures. Put on your wet suit, dive in, and sea what you can collect to earn miles. Sea what I did there, hm?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Collect a specified number of sea creatures

Achievements.Name: Underwater Understudy
Achievements.Achievement Description: There are still many creatures we have yet to discover at the bottom of the sea, hm? Earn miles by diving deep, capturing creatures, and filling out your Critterpedia. Yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Collect a specified number of unique sea creatures

Achievements.Name: DIY Tools
Achievements.Achievement Description: If your tools break, just make more! And to take away the sting, you'll earn Nook Miles based on the number of tools you craft. Sweet deal!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Craft a specified number of tools

Achievements.Name: DIY Furniture
Achievements.Achievement Description: Here's a win-win-win situation: Craft your own furniture. (Win!) Enjoy your handiwork. (Win!) Earn Nook Miles for the furniture you've crafted. (Win!) What could be better than that?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Craft a specified number of DIY furniture

Achievements.Name: Furniture Freshener
Achievements.Achievement Description: Give your furniture that personal touch and you can unlock miles. The more items you refurbish, the more miles you can get, hm?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Customize a specified number of furniture or tools using the workbench

Achievements.Name: Rough-hewn
Achievements.Achievement Description: Island development is Nook Inc.'s goal. We need a lot of materials to make that happen, so we're giving away Nook Miles based on how much wood you've chopped from trees.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Chop a specified number of wood from trees

Achievements.Name: Writing a Cookbook?
Achievements.Achievement Description: The recipes in your collection could stretch for miles, so allow me to present you with these...miles! Delight the eyes and stomachs of your neighbors with all your delicious creations, hm?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Learn a specified number of cooking DIY recipes

Achievements.Name: Mmm-Mmm-Miles!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Gathering ingredients and creating delicious treats is great fun, is it not? Yes, yes, I do believe our chefs out there deserve miles for all the times they've prepared something delicious!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Cook a specified number of foods

Achievements.Name: Trashed Tools
Achievements.Achievement Description: Using a tool until it breaks is proof of your hard work! In praise of your good deeds, you're getting Nook Miles based on how many tools you've broken.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Break a specified number of tools

Achievements.Name: Rock-Splitting Champ
Achievements.Achievement Description: You hit a single rock eight times in a row and knocked some things loose. But did you know that rock whacking is the activity that keeps on giving? Yes, yes! You're getting some Nook Miles now!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Hit a rock with your shovel and obtain all 8 materials from that rock

Achievements.Name: Bona Fide Bone Finder!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Congratulations on finding your first fossil! Of course, you'll need some Nook Miles to commemorate the occasion. But don't celebrate too hard. There are more fossils to dig up! Yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Dig up your first fossil

Achievements.Name: Fossil Assessment
Achievements.Achievement Description: Yes, yes! You're getting Nook Miles based on the number of fossils you've had assessed. Dig up as many as you can and find out what they are!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Have Blathers assess a specified number of fossils

Achievements.Name: Nice to Meet You, Gyroid!
Achievements.Achievement Description: You've discovered your first gyroid! This special occasion deserves miles, yes, yes. I hope you feel inspired to collect all sorts of different, wonderful gyroids now.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Dig up your first gyroid

Achievements.Name: Gyroid Getter
Achievements.Achievement Description: Collect different kinds of gyroids, and earn miles in return! I suspect once you experience life in their presence, you'll find it hard to resist hunting for more, hm?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Touch specified number of unique gyroids

Achievements.Name: Greedy Weeder
Achievements.Achievement Description: Nook Inc. salutes you for your beautification efforts. Nook Inc. rewards you with Nook Miles for selling weeds. Nook Inc. is quite generous, no?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Sell a specified number of weeds

Achievements.Name: Flower Power
Achievements.Achievement Description: Planting flowers makes our island more beautiful and can earn you miles. So...grow wild! Yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Plant a specified number of flower seeds (digging up and replanting existing flowers does not count)

Achievements.Name: Flower Tender
Achievements.Achievement Description: If you encourage floral growth by showering the island's flowers with water, I'll encourage your growth by showering you with Nook Miles!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Water a specified number of flowers

Achievements.Name: Tomorrow's Trees Today
Achievements.Achievement Description: To build a sustainable life on this island, we're going to need to plant a lot of trees! The more you plant, the more miles you can earn.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Plant a specified number of trees (planting fruits or replanting existing trees does not count)

Achievements.Name: Pick of the Bunch
Achievements.Achievement Description: You'll get Nook Miles based on the amount of fruit you've sold. Remember: If you sell our island's specialty fruits on other islands, you might be able to get a better price!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Sell a specified number of fruits

Achievements.Name: Fruit Roots
Achievements.Achievement Description: (island name)'s local fruit delicacy is a wonder, to be sure. But if you plant new varieties, guess what'll happen? Correct! You'll "grow" some Nook Miles! What you do with the fruit after that is up to you.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Plant each type of fruit (cherry, orange, pear, peach, apple, and coconut)

Achievements.Name: Shrubbery Hubbubbery
Achievements.Achievement Description: Different kinds of shrubs usher in the different seasons with their flowers, yes, yes! Folks who plant many shrubs will receive beauty and miles as a reward.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Plant a specified number of shrubs (replanting existing shrubs does not count)

Achievements.Name: Sprout Out Loud
Achievements.Achievement Description: Plant your produce starts across the whole island for a fresh, bounteous crop! Whether it's a small home garden or a full-on field, support Nook Inc. with all your produce-planting power! Yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Plant a specified number of produce sprouts (replanting existing sprouts does not count)

Achievements.Name: Executive Producer
Achievements.Achievement Description: Nothing feels quite like harvesting produce that you grew by the sweat of your brow, yes, yes! Now go enjoy the fruits of your labor—and the pumpkins, carrots, sugarcane, and potatoes too!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Harvest a specified number of produce

Achievements.Name: Go Ahead. Be Shellfish!
Achievements.Achievement Description: You can earn Nook Miles based on the number of seashells you sell. (That's not easy to say!) And remember: You'll get different amounts of Bells for different types of shells. So pay attention!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Sell a specified number of seashells

Achievements.Name: Clam and Collected
Achievements.Achievement Description: Dig up clams, collect Nook Miles. It's really that simple. The real bonus here is that you get to walk along the beach for this one.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Dig up a specified number of clams

Achievements.Name: Trash Fishin'
Achievements.Achievement Description: You work extra hard to keep our island clean, even going so far as to fish up trash out of our lovely waters. So you're getting some Nook Miles for keeping the island extra tidy, yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Fish a specified number of trash (cans, tires, or boots)

Achievements.Name: Cast Master
Achievements.Achievement Description: Cast your line carefully if you want to reel in this reward—you'll need to nab a bunch of fish in a row without a single one getting away to earn these miles.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Fish a specified number of fish in a single streak without any getting away

Achievements.Name: Dream House
Achievements.Achievement Description: A home that you build yourself gives you greater livability—it's on a whole other level! I'll give Nook Miles to those who build or expand their home to taste the good life.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Expand your home a specified number of times

Achievements.Name: Decorated Decorator
Achievements.Achievement Description: You got an S ranking from the Happy Home Academy! Your decorating skills are truly an inspiration, and you deserve some Nook Miles.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Get an S ranking from the Happy Home Academy

Achievements.Name: Hoard Reward
Achievements.Achievement Description: Put more furniture in your house! Nook Inc. will give you Nook Miles based on the number of indoor furniture items you have. So you're earning rewards for making your house a home!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Place a specified number of furniture in your house

Achievements.Name: Good Things in Store!
Achievements.Achievement Description: I'll reward you with miles based on the number of items you have in storage, hm? Using the convenient storage feature will make life on the island more pleasant!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Store a specified number of items in your house storage

Achievements.Name: Remarkable Remodeler
Achievements.Achievement Description: You finished remodeling your house, hm? It looks like a completely new house now! I'll give you rewards based on the number of remodels you do, so keep it up!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Remodel your home's exterior a specified number of times

Achievements.Name: Smile Isle
Achievements.Achievement Description: Good deeds are their own rewards. But go ahead and have some Nook Miles too for fulfilling requests from other island residents. Yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Fulfill a specified number of requests from residents (such as returning lost items)

Achievements.Name: Reaction Ruler
Achievements.Achievement Description: You learned a Reaction! Let's celebrate this momentous occasion with...Nook Miles, hm? Reactions help you express yourself, so it's a good idea to learn them.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Learn a specified number of reactions

Achievements.Name: Island Shutterbug
Achievements.Achievement Description: Congratulations on taking your first island photo! Please do show off your wonderful photos, whether they're impulse snaps or brilliant compositions.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you take a photo using the camera app on the NookPhone (screenshot button does not count, must use the app)

Achievements.Name: Edit Credit
Achievements.Achievement Description: Your passport has some information you can edit! Nook Inc. will give Nook Miles to folks who customize their profiles. Take it slow, think about it, and make it your own.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you edit your passport.

Achievements.Name: NookPhone Life
Achievements.Achievement Description: Gotten used to using your NookPhone? The fact that you're reading this probably means you have! Keep using it, and enjoy some Nook Miles just for getting familiar with it.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded after the 10th time you open your NookPhone

Achievements.Name: That's One Smart Phone
Achievements.Achievement Description: Nothing makes a smartphone manufacturer happier than a user who gets the most out of the device. At least, that's how Nook Inc. feels about the NookPhone. So we're giving you miles just for using your phone!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded after the 1000th time you open your NookPhone

Achievements.Name: Shop to It
Achievements.Achievement Description: Living on a remote island doesn't mean you have to go without life's luxuries. Shop to your heart's content with Nook Shopping and you'll earn Nook Miles!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of times you've ordered from the Nook Shopping catalog

Achievements.Name: Growing Collection
Achievements.Achievement Description: You are aware that furniture and clothing you buy is added to your Nook Shopping catalog, yes? Were you also aware that you can earn miles for a large catalog? Well, you certainly are aware now!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of unique furniture pieces you've added to your catalog

Achievements.Name: Nook Miles for Miles!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Earning Nook Miles for earning Nook Miles? Yes, yes! You just earned miles for finishing Nook Miles+ goals! But where will it end?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of Nook Miles+ goals you've completed

Achievements.Name: First-Time Buyer
Achievements.Achievement Description: You won't get miles every time you buy something on the island, but your first time is special! Enjoy these miles, courtesy of Nook Inc.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you purchase an item from a shop

Achievements.Name: Seller of Unwanted Stuff
Achievements.Achievement Description: Selling things you don't need is a great way to keep down the clutter and earn a few extra Bells. And, in this case, a few extra miles! Hooray for your first sale!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you sell an item to a shop

Achievements.Name: Moving Fees Paid!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Thank you for paying all your fees for moving to the island! Take a Nook Miles rebate as a gift and give yourself a nice pat on the back, hm?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded when you pay off your initial loan using Nook Miles

Achievements.Name: Bell Ringer
Achievements.Achievement Description: Spending your Bells on the island helps revitalize the local economy, yes, yes! I'll reward you with miles based on how many Bells you've spent.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of total bells you've spent in shops

Achievements.Name: Miles for Stalkholders
Achievements.Achievement Description: I have Nook Miles to give to any resident who purchases turnips. Buy them low, sell them high, and make a handsome profit! They'll rot in a week, though, so be careful.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you purchase turnips

Achievements.Name: Cornering the Stalk Market
Achievements.Achievement Description: The powers that be have been tracking your turnip transactions...and let's just say you've harvested your share of profits! Enjoy a few Nook Miles for helping contribute to the island's economy.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of total bells you've profited from selling turnips

Achievements.Name: No More Loan Payments!
Achievements.Achievement Description: You see how this works? You pay off your loan, you get some Nook Miles! Thank you for doing business with Nook Inc.!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded after paying off your first house loan with bells

Achievements.Name: Bulletin-Board Benefit
Achievements.Achievement Description: Picture this: Getting Nook Miles from Nook Inc. the first time you write something on an island's bulletin board. Keep using bulletin boards to communicate with everyone on the island! Yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you post a message on your town bulletin board

Achievements.Name: Popular Pen Pal
Achievements.Achievement Description: I'll reward you with miles if you send a lot of letters. Please keep sending letters to everyone and continuing to deepen friendships. Yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of letters you've sent

Achievements.Name: Flea Flicker
Achievements.Achievement Description: Itchy fleas are a real hassle. If you see an island buddy struggling with fleas, by all means, help them out. Not only is it a nice thing to do, but you'll also get some miles for doing a good deed.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of times you've caught fleas off a villager

Achievements.Name: Cicada Memories
Achievements.Achievement Description: Ah, cicada shells in the summer. They're not really all that useful, but collecting them does help create summer memories that will last a lifetime.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you catch a cicada shell

Achievements.Name: Netting Better!
Achievements.Achievement Description: It's so impressive when someone can catch five wasps in a row—so impressive, in fact, that you'll earn some Nook Miles if you can do it!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you catch five wasps in a row without running away or getting stung

Achievements.Name: Pit-y Party
Achievements.Achievement Description: Enjoy some bonus Nook Miles to commemorate the creation of your first pit. Just make sure you don't fall victim to your own handiwork!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you bury a pitfall seed

Achievements.Name: Taking the Sting Out
Achievements.Achievement Description: Getting stung by wasps hurts! Getting stung again before you can recover makes you faint! But at least you get some miles for that. I don't want you to be uncomfortable, though, so take some medicine to heal up!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you get stung by a wasp

Achievements.Name: Faint of Heart
Achievements.Achievement Description: This island is home to creepy crawlers that would make anyone light-headed. Maybe wielding a net will make you less likely to faint...
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you get knocked out by a Scorpion or Tarantula

Achievements.Name: Overcoming Pitfalls
Achievements.Achievement Description: Life is full of peaks and valleys, hills and pits. When you fall into a pit, you learn a lesson, hm? Be more careful next time, yes? Don't feel too bad, though. You're getting some bonus Nook Miles for your fall.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you fall into a pitfall hole

Achievements.Name: Faked Out!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Oh my. Did you get hoodwinked? That work of art you tried to donate turned out to be a forgery, and it stings. Your eye for art is being tested! Yes, yes! Please take some comfort in the miles I'm giving you.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Donated a fake piece of art

Achievements.Name: Lost Treasure
Achievements.Achievement Description: Oh my. You popped a balloon with a skillful shot, but the attached prize fell into the water! Maybe some Nook Miles will help you recover from that sunken feeling, hm?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time a balloon present you shot lands in a body of water

Achievements.Name: It's Raining Treasure!
Achievements.Achievement Description: No one knows who sends the gifts attached to balloons to our island, but you can earn miles by shooting them down and collecting what's inside.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of balloons you've shot down with a slingshot

Achievements.Name: Fun with Fences
Achievements.Achievement Description: You can have a wonderful yard in no time by building a fence and surrounding your home or garden. Yes, yes! Nook Inc. will award Nook Miles to skilled fence installers.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you place a fence

Achievements.Name: Snowmaestro
Achievements.Achievement Description: What's this? You get Nook Miles based on how many quality snowfolks you've built? That's a pretty good deal for just having a little fun in the snow.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of perfect snow-people you've built

Achievements.Name: Wishes Come True
Achievements.Achievement Description: Were you wishing for Nook Miles the last time you saw a shooting star? Hm? Because Nook Inc. is here to grant your wish. More wishes, more miles! Yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of shooting stars you've wished on

Achievements.Name: Exterior Decorator
Achievements.Achievement Description: You can display furniture outside, right? Well, here's a little incentive for you to show off what you've got—you'll earn Nook Miles based on the number of furniture items you set up outside.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you place some furniture outside

Achievements.Name: (island name) Icons
Achievements.Achievement Description: At Resident Services, we want new ideas for the island flag and island tune. We have Nook Miles in store for those creative types who can redesign and rewrite! It's good to take pride in our island symbols.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded for changing your island flag and town tune for the first time.

Achievements.Name: Island Designer
Achievements.Achievement Description: At Nook Inc. we encourage the use of the Island Designer app to liven up the island. We're giving away miles the first time you use a permit for a path, river, or cliff!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you use the Island Designer app to place a path, add/remove water, and build/destroy a cliff

Achievements.Name: Wispy Island Secrets
Achievements.Achievement Description: If you happen to encounter one of the island's secrets, maybe just keep it to yourself. We don't want to scare anyone away from here. Pretty sure that's in your island contract...
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of times you've helped Wisp find the parts of his spirit

Achievements.Name: Gulliver's Travails
Achievements.Achievement Description: When you come across someone in trouble on the beach, you help them, setting a fine example for all the island residents. Such kindness will surely find its way back to you.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of times you've helped Gulliver fix his communicator

Achievements.Name: K.K. Mania
Achievements.Achievement Description: K.K. supports our island with his groovy brand of folk rock, so we should support him! The more K.K. shows you attend, the more Nook Miles you can earn.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of K.K. shows you've attended

Achievements.Name: True Patron of the Arts
Achievements.Achievement Description: Collecting artwork contributes to the cultural quality of (island name), and Nook Inc. will give miles to folks who prove themselves discerning connoisseurs.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of times you've purchased art that turned out to be real

Achievements.Name: You Otter Know
Achievements.Achievement Description: If you meet a laid-back fellow floating in the sea, consider sharing some of your scallops with him. You never know what you might learn in return...and a little gift never hurts either!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of times you've given scallops to Pascal

Achievements.Name: Set Sail for Adventure
Achievements.Achievement Description: Rare items and exciting adventures are yours when you head out on a special tour with a veteran sailor, yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of times you've gone on a Kapp'n tour

Achievements.Name: Come Home to the Roost

Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of days you've gotten coffee from Brewster

Achievements.Name: Stretch to Refresh!
Achievements.Achievement Description: The health of our residents is a top priority, yes, yes! So we're holding group-stretching sessions in the plaza. I'll provide miles once per day for participating, and there will be a tape deck for music. I hope I see you there!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of days you've participated in group stretching

Achievements.Name: Decorate a Hotel Room
Achievements.Achievement Description: The island hotel is looking for folks who can help decorate the guest rooms. You'll earn miles based on how many days you help. Lend a hand, and make our guests feel welcome!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: NA

Achievements.Name: Take Tourists to the Hotel
Achievements.Achievement Description: Sometimes tourists visit the island without booking a room. If you'd be so kind as to take them to our hotel, we'll give you some miles as a thank-you!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: NA

Achievements.Name: DIY Goods Wanted!
Achievements.Achievement Description: We're collecting DIY goods to promote the island! Please drop the requested items in the box by the pier. Rewards and miles await, yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: NA

Achievements.Name: True Friends
Achievements.Achievement Description: It's good news for Nook Inc. when island residents get along. Good relationships are a cornerstone of island development!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of villagers you've become good friends with

Achievements.Name: Birthday Celebration
Achievements.Achievement Description: Celebrating the birthday of a fellow resident is a wonderful thing. Nook Inc. will commemorate your bond with some party-favor Nook Miles.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of villager birthdays you've attended

Achievements.Name: Happy Birthday!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Happy birthday to you! Take some Nook Miles, woo-hoo! Happy birthday to you-oo! Take some Nook Miles, woo-hoo! (Get yourself something nice.)
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you play on your character's birthday

Achievements.Name: Fishing Tourney!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Please participate in the Fishing Tourney, which is held every spring, summer, fall, and winter! I'll give you Nook Miles as a reward the first time you participate each season.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you attend a fishing tourney in each season

Achievements.Name: Bug-Off!
Achievements.Achievement Description: What's the summer event to look forward to? That's right...the Bug-Off! Nook Inc. will give you Nook Miles for participating, so by all means, join the fun!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you attend a bug-off tourney in each season

Achievements.Name: Countdown Celebration
Achievements.Achievement Description: The only thing better than ringing in the new year is ringing in the new year with some Nook Miles! May you live to see many more—years and miles!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded for attending the new year holiday event

Achievements.Name: Making a Change
Achievements.Achievement Description: A closet is a must-have item for a fashion trendsetter. I'll offer Nook Miles to anyone who has a closet and changes outfits, thereby increasing the chances of an island fashion trend catching on.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you use a wardrobe to change your character's outfit

Achievements.Name: First Custom Design!
Achievements.Achievement Description: Learning to use the Custom Design app lets you personalize your clothes and furniture. So much fun to be had, yes, yes!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you use the Custom Design app to edit or create a design

Achievements.Name: Custom Design Pro!
Achievements.Achievement Description: You upgraded to the Pro version of the Custom Design app, hm? That makes you a fine Pro Custom Designer. Yes, yes! I'll reward you with Nook Miles to commemorate your Pro debut!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you use the Custom Design pro app to edit or create a design

Achievements.Name: Paydirt!
Achievements.Achievement Description: I'll bet you didn't think you'd find buried Bells here, hm? But this is an island, after all. Buried treasure and whatnot. Enjoy some Nook Miles from Nook Inc. to celebrate your discovery.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded the first time you dig up bells from a shining spot

Achievements.Name: Shady Shakedown
Achievements.Achievement Description: Rumor has it that someone on this island likes to hide furniture in trees. Yes, yes! I'll give you Nook Miles based on the number of furniture items you shake out of trees. So get out there and shake!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of furniture pieces you've found from shaking trees

Achievements.Name: Golden Milestone
Achievements.Achievement Description: If your tools are glinting gold, your account will be bursting with Bells soon enough. The paths to these tools are varied and secret, but you will have earned some Nook Miles for collecting them all.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Awarded for each unique golden tool you've equipped (shovel, net, fishing rod, watering can, axe, and slingshot)

Achievements.Name: Island and Yourland
Achievements.Achievement Description: Support your neighboring islands with a visit now and again. The more you visit, the more Nook Miles you can earn! Here at Nook Inc. we like to reward your adventurous spirit, hm?
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of times you've visited another player's island (does not count mystery islands using Nook Miles Tickets)

Achievements.Name: Host the Most
Achievements.Achievement Description: To encourage you to invite plenty of guests to the island, we're offering miles as an incentive. The more the merrier— and that goes for Nook Miles too!
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of other players that have visited your island

Achievements.Name: Active Island Resident
Achievements.Achievement Description: Life on the island has lots of promise, hm? To illustrate this, I'll award you some Nook Miles based on the number of active days you've spent here. Please take them and enjoy them.
Achievements.Achievement Criteria: Number of total unique days you've played the game
